title: Charge for Recording a Transfer of Membership and Patronage Equity, by the Age of the Registered Instruction
content:
A file the desk has had to carry costs more to work than one signed this week, so the charge for recording a transfer follows the age of the instruction registered on the membership and the equity standing on it.

**Where the instruction has been carried.** Where the transfer instruction registered on the membership has stood more than 30 days and the equity standing is above the class's minimum equity balance, the recording charge is 40.00.

**Where the instruction is fresh.** Where that instruction has stood 30 days or fewer and the equity standing is above the class's minimum equity balance, the recording charge is 25.00.

**Where no instruction stands registered.** Where no transfer instruction stands registered on the membership at all, the class's own transfer fee applies, since there is no file whose age could tell against it.

**Where the equity standing does not clear the class floor.** The first two lines each require the equity standing to be above the class's minimum equity balance. Where it is not, the class's own transfer fee applies.

## Points of judgement on hypothetical figures

| Days the registered instruction has stood | Equity standing | Class minimum equity balance | Recording charge |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 44 | 8510.00 | 25.00 | 40.00 |
| 30 | 8510.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 |
| 12 | 8510.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 |
| 44 | 20.00 | 25.00 | the class's own transfer fee |
| no instruction registered | 8510.00 | 25.00 | the class's own transfer fee |

The boundary is at 30 days: an instruction standing exactly 30 days has not stood more than 30, so 25.00 is the charge and not 40.00. The days are counted from the date the latest registered transfer instruction on the Membership and Patronage Equity account was requested.
